q.en: Q11. A Campus Shuttle Application displays shuttle routes, provides arrival alerts, and uses the device location to help students find nearby stops. Explain how each of the five Android architecture layers supports this application. Give one practical example for each layer.
q.id: Q11. Aplikasi Campus Shuttle menampilkan rute shuttle, memberi peringatan kedatangan, dan memakai lokasi perangkat untuk membantu mahasiswa menemukan halte terdekat. Jelaskan bagaimana setiap dari lima layer arsitektur Android mendukung aplikasi ini. Beri satu contoh praktis untuk tiap layer.

model.en:
Applications: the shuttle app itself, e.g. the screen listing routes and arrival times.
Application Framework: Notification Manager sends the arrival alert; Location Manager gives the device position.
Android Runtime: ART runs the Java/Kotlin code of the app.
Platform Libraries: SQLite stores routes and stops; OpenGL draws the map.
Linux Kernel: GPS and Wi-Fi drivers provide the location data.
model.id:
Applications: app shuttle itu sendiri, misalnya layar daftar rute dan jam kedatangan.
Application Framework: Notification Manager mengirim peringatan kedatangan; Location Manager memberi posisi perangkat.
Android Runtime: ART menjalankan kode Java/Kotlin app.
Platform Libraries: SQLite menyimpan rute dan halte; OpenGL menggambar peta.
Linux Kernel: driver GPS dan Wi-Fi menyediakan data lokasi.

q.en: Q12. Parking Fee Calculator: Rs. 100 per hour. Users enter the number of hours, tap Calculate, and view the total fee. (a) Interface layout (4): labeled layout, components, parent layout. (b) Implementation logic (6): initialize components, handle the click, read hours, compute, update output. (c) Input validation (3): reject empty, non-numeric, zero or negative; show the error. (d) Sample output (2): fee for 3 hours.
q.id: Q12. Parking Fee Calculator: Rs. 100 per jam. User memasukkan jumlah jam, menekan Calculate, dan melihat total biaya. (a) Layout (4): layout berlabel, komponen, parent layout. (b) Logika (6): inisialisasi komponen, tangani klik, baca jam, hitung, perbarui output. (c) Validasi (3): tolak kosong, bukan angka, nol atau negatif; tampilkan error. (d) Contoh output (2): biaya untuk 3 jam.

model.en:
(a) Parent: vertical LinearLayout. EditText etHours (inputType=number, hint "Enter hours"), Button btnCalc ("Calculate"), TextView tvResult.
(b) onCreate: find etHours, btnCalc, tvResult with findViewById. btnCalc.setOnClickListener: text = etHours.getText().toString(); (validate); hours = Integer.parseInt(text); fee = hours * 100; tvResult.setText("Total Fee: Rs. " + fee).
(c) Empty: etHours.setError("Enter hours"); return. Not a number: catch NumberFormatException, setError("Numbers only"); return. hours <= 0: setError("Must be > 0"); return.
(d) 3 × 100 = 300, so the screen shows: Total Fee: Rs. 300
model.id:
(a) Parent: LinearLayout vertikal. EditText etHours (inputType=number, hint "Enter hours"), Button btnCalc ("Calculate"), TextView tvResult.
(b) onCreate: temukan etHours, btnCalc, tvResult dengan findViewById. btnCalc.setOnClickListener: text = etHours.getText().toString(); (validasi); hours = Integer.parseInt(text); fee = hours * 100; tvResult.setText("Total Fee: Rs. " + fee).
(c) Kosong: etHours.setError("Enter hours"); return. Bukan angka: tangkap NumberFormatException, setError("Numbers only"); return. hours <= 0: setError("Must be > 0"); return.
(d) 3 × 100 = 300, jadi layar menampilkan: Total Fee: Rs. 300

q.en: Q13. Study Session Planner: enter a study subject, choose a start time, save the plan so it is shown again when the app is reopened. (a) Interface layout (4): subject field, Select Time button, selected-time display, Save Plan button, saved-plan display. (b) Event handling (6): initialize views, open a TimePickerDialog, show the selected time, show subject and time on Save Plan. (c) Local storage (3): SharedPreferences save and restore. (d) Validation (2): empty subject or no time selected.
q.id: Q13. Study Session Planner: isi subjek belajar, pilih jam mulai, simpan rencana agar tampil lagi saat app dibuka ulang. (a) Layout (4): kolom subjek, tombol Select Time, tampilan jam terpilih, tombol Save Plan, tampilan rencana tersimpan. (b) Event handling (6): inisialisasi view, buka TimePickerDialog, tampilkan jam terpilih, tampilkan subjek dan jam saat Save Plan. (c) Penyimpanan lokal (3): simpan dan pulihkan dengan SharedPreferences. (d) Validasi (2): subjek kosong atau jam belum dipilih.

model.en:
(a) Vertical LinearLayout: EditText etSubject, Button btnTime ("Select Time"), TextView tvTime, Button btnSave ("Save Plan"), TextView tvPlan.
(b) btnTime.setOnClickListener: new TimePickerDialog(this, (view, hour, minute) -> { selectedTime = hour + ":" + minute; tvTime.setText(selectedTime); }, 8, 0, true).show(). btnSave.setOnClickListener: (validate); tvPlan.setText("Subject: " + subject + ", Time: " + selectedTime).
(c) Save: prefs = getSharedPreferences("study", MODE_PRIVATE); prefs.edit().putString("subject", subject).putString("time", selectedTime).apply(). Restore in onCreate: prefs.getString("subject", "") and prefs.getString("time", ""); if not empty, show them in tvPlan.
(d) Empty subject: etSubject.setError("Enter subject"); return. No time selected: Toast "Select a time first"; return.
model.id:
(a) LinearLayout vertikal: EditText etSubject, Button btnTime ("Select Time"), TextView tvTime, Button btnSave ("Save Plan"), TextView tvPlan.

model.en:
(a) ScrollView + vertical LinearLayout; TextView per item name, EditText (number) per quantity, Button "Place Order", TextView total.
(b) total = 0; for i in items: total += price[i] * quantity[i]; totalText.setText("Total: " + total).

(d) SharedPreferences (simple last-order value).

(b) total = 0; untuk tiap item: total += harga[i] * jumlah[i]; totalText.setText("Total: " + total).
(c) Nama pelanggan tidak boleh kosong (setError); jumlah tidak boleh negatif.
(d) SharedPreferences (nilai pesanan terakhir yang sederhana).

q.en: Explain the flow of the Weather Forecast app from tapping Search to showing the result, and why a background thread is used.
q.id: Jelaskan alur app Weather Forecast dari menekan Search sampai hasil tampil, dan kenapa background thread dipakai.

model.en: Tap Search → validate the city (empty → setError) → show ProgressBar and disable the button → on a background thread call the geocoding API (city → latitude/longitude) → call the forecast API → parse the JSON → runOnUiThread: show current weather and the 3-day forecast, hide ProgressBar. Errors (city not found, no network) show a message. The background thread is used because network calls on the main thread would freeze the UI. The Manifest needs the INTERNET permission.
model.id: Tekan Search → validasi kota (kosong → setError) → tampilkan ProgressBar dan nonaktifkan tombol → di background thread panggil geocoding API (kota → lintang/bujur) → panggil forecast API → parse JSON → runOnUiThread: tampilkan cuaca sekarang dan prakiraan 3 hari, sembunyikan ProgressBar. Error (kota tidak ditemukan, tanpa jaringan) menampilkan pesan. Background thread dipakai karena panggilan jaringan di main thread akan membekukan UI. Manifest butuh permission INTERNET.
